title: heliopsis helianthoides
intro: Heliopsis helianthoides, commonly known as Oxeye Sunflower, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Heliopsis helianthoides include its ability to calm the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
